scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix loyalty-service && npm install --prefix event-bus && npm install --prefix loyalty-client && npm install --prefix cafe-app && npm install --prefix cinema-app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n loyalty,bus,cafe,cinema -c magenta,yellow,red,cyan "node --no-warnings loyalty-service/src/server.js" "node event-bus/src/server.js" "node --no-warnings cafe-app/src/server.js" "node --no-warnings cinema-app/src/server.js"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix loyalty-service && npm test --prefix event-bus && npm test --prefix loyalty-client && npm test --prefix cafe-app && npm test --prefix cinema-app
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n bus,cafe,cinema -c yellow,red,cyan "node event-bus/src/server.js" "node --no-warnings cafe-app/src/server.js" "node --no-warnings cinema-app/src/server.js"
